service.name: Toronto Birthday Parties
service.description: Curated directory of kids birthday party venues in the Greater Toronto Area with verified party packages, pricing, ratings and kid-fit scores.
audience: Parents planning a child's birthday party

capabilities.name: Browse venues by city
capabilities.description: Filter 92 verified venues across 14 GTA cities, sorted by Google rating.

capabilities.name: Venue details
capabilities.description: Per-venue page with rating, review count, party package pricing, phone, website and Google Maps link.

capabilities.name: List a venue
capabilities.description: Free listing requests, updates and removals via the contact page.

capabilities.name: Site search
capabilities.description: Keyword search across all venue names, cities and tags from the homepage.
